author: Alycia McNamara
title: Prince Harry's Diana doc idea faces huge blow from brother William as feud continues - NewsBreak
text:
By Alycia McNamara Hollie Beale ,
9 hours ago
Prince Harry and Prince William are both reportedly planning separate projects for next year to commemorate the 30th anniversary of their mother's passing.
Princess Diana died in a car crash in Paris in 1997 when the two brothers were just young boys.
Nearly three decades later, speculation is building about how the Royal Family will honor the milestone. Prince Harry is said to be in discussions to produce a Netflix documentary about his mother, and has purportedly reached out to family members for participation.
Reports now indicate Prince William is also weighing involvement in a documentary - though not his brother's production.
According to Richard Eden in the Daily Mail: "This is serendipitous. Yesterday, I disclosed that the Prince of Wales was considering appearing in a television documentary to mark the 30th anniversary of his late mother Princess Diana's death.
"Now, I learn that Prince William held private talks at Kensington Palace yesterday with the new Director-General of the BBC, Matt Brittin."
"On the 20th anniversary of his mother's death in 2017, William appeared with his brother, Prince Harry, in the same BBC documentary - Diana, Our Mother: Her Life And Legacy. That won't happen again given the brothers' estrangement.
"Harry is planning to make his own programme, probably for US streaming giant Netflix."
Prince Harry is reportedly in talks with Netflix Princess Diana's funeral was held on September 6, 1997 The two brothers remain estranged and are believed to have no contact. Prince Harry relocated back to the United Kingdom at the end of August, following his departure from royal duties in 2020, when he and his wife, Meghan Markle, settled in the USA.
The Sussexes have now made their return to British soil, accompanied by their two children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet.
The family is reportedly planning an extended stay in the UK for the foreseeable future.
Prince Harry met with his father, King Charles, in July, though it is understood that he has yet to meet with his brother.
King Charles and Queen Camilla welcomed the Sussexes and their two children for a private gathering at Highgrove House.
The King has reportedly conveyed his enthusiasm for spending more time with his family, particularly his grandchildren, whom he had not seen in four years, since 2022.
